newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 12.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Maple-Brown Abbott Ltd increased its relevant interest in Goldfields Limited. on 06/02/1997, from 14,636,600 ordinary shares (6.06%) to 17,410,231 ordinary shares (7.21%).
Guinness Peat Group plc ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) on 06/02/1997.
- - - - SAS Trustee Corporation ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Portman Mining Limited on 07/02/1997.

Carlton & United Breweries Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) on 10/02/1997, from 24,194,328 ordinary shares (89.29%) to 24,707,973 ordinary shares (91.19%).
The Capital Group Companies Inc increased its relevant interest in Westpac Banking Corporation on 06/02/1997, from 115,265,048 ordinary shares (6.07%) to 134,337,326 ordinary shares (7.07%).
Peter Leon Lehmann became a substantial shareholder in Peter Lehmann Wines Limited on 11/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,801,415 ordinary shares (22.87%).
AMP Society became a substantial shareholder in Mayne Nickless Limited on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 15,616,859 ordinary shares (5.00%).

Thorney Holdings Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Dollar Sweets Holdings Limited on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 4,600,000 fully paid ordinary shares (7.28%).
Redsummer Pty Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Central West Media Limited on 06/02/1997, from 2,021,935 ordinary shares (53.8%) to 1,791,935 ordinary shares (47.6%).
Zicom Private Limited changed its relevant interest in Quokka Investments Limited on 11/12/1996, from 24,145,951 ordinary shares (47.33%) to 24,145,951 ordinary shares (40.34%).
David Brian Clarke increased its relevant interest in Stuart Metals NL on 05/02/1997, from 6,074,000 fully paid ordinary shares (29.17%) to 6,423,315 ordinary shares (30.85%).
Ausdoc Employee Share Plan Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Ausdoc Group Limited on 11/02/1997.
Anthony Barton increased its relevant interest in Amity Oil NL on 06/02/1997, from 4,417,292 ordinary shares (6.91%) to 5,366,625 ordinary shares (8.39%).
European Pacific Resources Pty Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Hillcrest Resources NL on 21/01/1997, from 1,937,302 ordinary shares (8.67%) to 1,877,302 ordinary shares (8.44%).
